headline: Imran Khan jailed in Pakistan; global cricketers demand fair treatment
summary: Former Pakistan PM and World Cup-winning captain Imran Khan is imprisoned. Prominent cricketers worldwide are speaking out, demanding his fair treatment and humane rights during his incarceration.
details: World-renowned cricketers are raising their voices in support of former Pakistan captain and Prime Minister Imran Khan, who is currently imprisoned. They are advocating for his proper medical care and humane treatment while in jail.

Khan, a celebrated figure in cricket history and a former World Cup-winning captain, faces incarceration. His supporters, including global sporting icons, are concerned about his well-being and rights.

The appeal from the cricketing fraternity highlights concerns over the conditions of Khan's detention. They are urging Pakistani authorities to ensure he receives adequate medical attention and is treated with dignity.

topic: Woman dies after collision with state minister's SUV
headline_marked: [[70-year-old woman dies]] after being hit by state minister's SUV in Bogura
headline: 70-year-old woman dies after being hit by state minister's SUV in Bogura
summary: An SUV carrying State Minister Abdul Bari swerved off the road and fell into a paddy field while trying to avoid hitting a woman, police said. The 70-year-old victim later died from her injuries.
details: A 70-year-old woman has died in Bogura after being struck by an SUV carrying State Minister for Public Administration and Food Abdul Bari. The incident occurred in Shibganj upazila.

Police reported that the SUV veered off the Bogura-Joypurhat road and landed in a paddy field as it attempted to evade the woman. The deceased has been identified as Firoza Begum from Gopinathpur village.

The accident took place around 9:00 am while the state minister was en route from Dhaka to Joypurhat. Firoza Begum was transported to TMSS Medical College and Rafatullah Community Hospital in Bogura, where she passed away during treatment.
State Minister Abdul Bari sustained an injury to his right leg during the incident. He was scheduled to travel to Dhaka for medical attention later in the afternoon.
caption:

The vehicle swerved off the road and fell into a paddy field while trying to avoid the victim.

A 70-year-old woman has died in Bogura after being struck by an SUV carrying State Minister for Public Administration and Food Abdul Bari. The incident occurred in Shibganj upazila.

Police reported that the SUV veered off the Bogura-Joypurhat road and landed in a paddy field as it attempted to evade the woman. The deceased has been identified as Firoza Begum from Gopinathpur village.

The accident took place around 9:00 am while the state minister was en route from Dhaka to Joypurhat. Firoza Begum was transported to TMSS Medical College and Rafatullah Community Hospital in Bogura, where she passed away during treatment.

State Minister Abdul Bari sustained an injury to his right leg during the incident. He was scheduled to travel to Dhaka for medical attention later in the afternoon.
